items.title: Trump made more than $1bn from crypto in first year back in office
items.description: The president's crypto income far outpaces his earnings from real estate and Trump-themed items such as watches.

items.title: Three-year-old rescued and taken to hospital six days after Venezuela quake
items.description: Video footage shows rescuers cheering as the child is pulled from rubble in La Guaira state.

items.title: US Supreme Court upholds birthright citizenship in blow to Trump
items.description: The ruling is a major setback for Donald Trump's immigration agenda, and has been welcomed by civil rights groups.

items.title: Three killed in Mexico City World Cup celebrations
items.description: More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City on Tuesday to mark the country's win over Ecuador.

items.title: A plane crashed into a tower in Beijing but China is not saying what happened
items.description: The collision left holes on the side of the tower, but Beijing has scrubbed other visible traces of the incident.

items.title: Sudan's RSF committed crimes against humanity in el-Fasher, Amnesty says
items.description: The Amnesty report adds to evidence of atrocities in el-Fasher, which the UN says bore the hallmarks of genocide.

items.title: Roof collapse kills 14 children at Pakistan tuition centre
items.description: Two people are taken into custody after the incident in the Kahna suburb of Lahore.

items.title: Afghan Taliban launch strikes on border with Pakistan as tensions escalate
items.description: Pakistan's military says it shot down four rudimentary drones and will respond to any further provocation.

items.title: Anthropic says US lifts export ban on its advanced AI tools
items.description: Fable and Mythos were abruptly suspended in June over concerns that they could be used by hackers.

items.title: US envoys in Doha to meet mediators but not Iranians, Qatar says
items.description: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman says no high-level meetings or direct talks between the US and Iran are scheduled.

items.title: Firefighters struggle to contain deadly Greek wildfire
items.description: More than 100 firefighters are fighting a fire near Thessaloniki which has claimed at least two lives.

items.title: 'Absolute madness': Row over plan to demolish Nazi bunker under Berlin
items.description: City officials want to build flats on the city centre site but others say it should be preserved as part of Germany's history.
